history.note: needs missing engine capability: targets for TRIGGERED chain items are chosen at resolution (resolve.ts executeResolvedItem), never at finalization (355.5). choseAtFinalize is hardcoded to non-triggered items and fireTriggers/addToChain cannot pause for a pendingChoice. Adding finalize-time binding means a new choose-target variant carrying chainItemId plus duplicating resolve.ts's option pipeline (deflect tax, any-number/upTo, hidden-zone, sequence lead) — global prompt-ordering change for every triggered ability, too broad to land safely in this lane.
already fixed upstream; repro test passes
